radiusSource: Radius 4.175 (4.080 to 4.271) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 2,904,575 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 3.040 (2.997 to 3.083) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 9823 +/- 80.2 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 2414783622022208128: teff_gspphot 9823.439 K (16th-84th percentiles 9758.921-9919.38), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
